subject.title: refactor: separate external conversations from local sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these owner-only conversation tools, Gateway methods, and v11 durable conversation data model as the permanent core contract?
rationale: The patch adds a new model-facing tool family, public Gateway protocol methods, plugin-facing delivery semantics, and a persistent migration; tests can validate implementation but cannot choose whether this is the desired long-term product boundary.

options.title: Adopt after blockers
options.body: Accept the conversation/session architecture after cancellation is made authoritative and live Reef plus v10-upgrade proof is attached.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Land only the generic conversation registry and send path, deferring correlated turns and their durable reply state until separately proven.

options.title: Keep transport-specific
options.body: Reject the new core contract and solve the immediate Reef workflow inside the plugin using existing generic message APIs.

recommendation.title: Adopt after blockers
recommendation.body: Accept the conversation/session architecture after cancellation is made authoritative and live Reef plus v10-upgrade proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent session/Gateway history and authored the sustained architecture work represented by the branch.
